title: Ligue 1 title-winning managers 2016/17 to 2025/26
brief: Name the manager who won the French league title in each season from 2016/17 to 2025/26.

notes.Raynald Denoueix: Raynald Denoueix won the title with Nantes in 2000/01, outside these seasons.
notes.Jacques Santini: Jacques Santini won the title with Lyon in 2001/02, outside these seasons.
notes.Paul Le Guen: Paul Le Guen won the title with Lyon in 2002/03, 2003/04, 2004/05, outside these seasons.
notes.Gerard Houllier: Gerard Houllier won the title with Lyon in 2005/06, 2006/07, outside these seasons.
notes.Alain Perrin: Alain Perrin won the title with Lyon in 2007/08, outside these seasons.
notes.Laurent Blanc: Laurent Blanc won the title with Bordeaux in 2008/09, 2013/14, 2014/15, 2015/16, outside these seasons.
notes.Didier Deschamps: Didier Deschamps won the title with Marseille in 2009/10, outside these seasons.
notes.Rudi Garcia: Rudi Garcia won the title with Lille in 2010/11, outside these seasons.
notes.Rene Girard: Rene Girard won the title with Montpellier in 2011/12, outside these seasons.
notes.Carlo Ancelotti: Carlo Ancelotti won the title with PSG in 2012/13, outside these seasons.
notes.Claude Puel: Puel won the title with Monaco in 1999/00, before 2000/01; he won none in these seasons.

checks: Champions and their coaches from Transfermarkt's Ligue 1 winners page, checked against the manager column of each Wikipedia season article's personnel table (2004/05 onward). For 2000/01 Wikipedia names Denoueix as manager of the year with champions Nantes; for 2001/02 to 2003/04 (Santini, then Le Guen at Lyon) and 2025/26 (Luis Enrique) the season articles have no manager table, so these were checked against the managers' own Wikipedia articles and the club manager lists. Most slots for one manager: 3.
